clusters.name: Women's Heels
clusters.notes: Highest-demand head cluster (~495k impr on 'heels for women'). Page ranks pos ~7-9 -> big upside from pushing to top 3. Pillar collection for women's footwear.

clusters.name: Platform & Transparent Heels
clusters.notes: Already strong (pos 3.8-5.6). Transparent-heel keywords have their own page (transparent-heel-for-women); maintain and expand. Trend/party sub-cluster.

clusters.name: Women's Sandals
clusters.notes: Top revenue cluster (2011 clicks, 421k impr on head term). Occasion modifiers (office/party/daily wear) are winnable long-tails at lower difficulty.

clusters.name: Women's Flats
clusters.notes: 253k impr head term at pos 5.45. Comfort + casual sub-intent; pair with 'comfortable footwear' messaging.

clusters.name: Women's Wedges
clusters.notes: Strong performer (pos 5.27). 'daily wear' variant already ranks pos 3.8 - protect it.

clusters.name: Women's Mules
clusters.notes: 41k impr on 'mules' but page ranks pos 6-9.5 -> on-page + internal-link upside.

clusters.name: Women's Boots
clusters.notes: 180k impr head term but weak rank (pos 8.75) -> priority on-page fix. Seasonal (winter) demand.

clusters.name: Women's Footwear / Pumps / Ethnic
clusters.notes: Broad category hub (132k impr) plus pumps and ethnic sub-collections. Ethnic ties to Indian occasion calendar (festive/wedding).

clusters.name: Men's Footwear
clusters.notes: Large latent demand (196k impr on 'sandals for men', only 128 clicks -> huge CTR/rank gap). Formal shoes and Privo leather sandals are secondary growth lines.

clusters.name: Handbags & Accessories
clusters.notes: 'shoulder bags for women' has 79k impr but only 31 clicks (pos 7.75) - biggest CTR gap on site. Distinct pages for sling/shoulder/clutch.
